epa_hazwaste.e_manifest.label: MANIFEST TRACKING NUMBER
epa_hazwaste.e_manifest.description: Unique EPA manifest tracking number (MTN) for the hazardous waste shipment; 9 digits plus a 3-character suffix (e.g. 012345678ELC). Primary key of the manifest.

epa_hazwaste.e_manifest.label: UPDATED DATE
epa_hazwaste.e_manifest.description: Date the manifest record was last updated in EPA's e-Manifest system.

epa_hazwaste.e_manifest.label: SHIPPED DATE
epa_hazwaste.e_manifest.description: Date the hazardous waste shipment departed the generator site; start of the cradle-to-grave chain.

epa_hazwaste.e_manifest.label: RECEIVED DATE
epa_hazwaste.e_manifest.description: Date the designated receiving facility acknowledged receipt of the waste.

epa_hazwaste.e_manifest.label: STATUS
epa_hazwaste.e_manifest.description: Manifest lifecycle status in e-Manifest (Pending, Scheduled, InTransit, ReadyForSignature, Received, Signed, Corrected).

epa_hazwaste.e_manifest.label: SUBMISSION TYPE
epa_hazwaste.e_manifest.description: How the manifest was submitted to e-Manifest: FullElectronic, Hybrid, DataImage5Copy, or Image.

epa_hazwaste.e_manifest.label: ORIGIN TYPE
epa_hazwaste.e_manifest.description: Origin classification of the manifest: Service (routine shipment), Rejection, or Residue.

epa_hazwaste.e_manifest.label: GENERATOR ID
epa_hazwaste.e_manifest.description: EPA ID number (RCRA site ID) of the hazardous waste generator; first two characters are the state postal code.

epa_hazwaste.e_manifest.description: Name of the hazardous waste generator listed on the manifest.

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: ISN_RCR_EVAL

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: EVAL_TYPE

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: EVAL_TYPE_DESC

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: EVAL_IDENTIFIER
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.description: Identifier of the specific evaluation activity in RCRAInfo.

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: EVAL_LEAD_AGENCY

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: EVAL_ACTIVITY_LOCATION

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: EVAL_DATE
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.description: Date the RCRA compliance evaluation was conducted.

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: VIOL_TYPE

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: VIOL_SEQ

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: VIOL_ACTIVITY_LOCATION
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.description: Two-character state postal code where the violation was recorded.

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: VIOL_DETERMINED_BY_AGENCY

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: VIOL_AGENCY

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: VIOL_DETERMINED_DATE

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: ACTUAL_RTC_DATE
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.description: Actual return-to-compliance date: the date the facility actually returned to compliance (MM/DD/YYYY string).

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: VIOL_RTC_DATE
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.description: Scheduled/recorded return-to-compliance date for the violation (MM/DD/YYYY string).

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: FOUND_VIOLATION
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.description: Indicates whether a violation was found for the evaluation (populated when a violation determination exists).

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: ENF_TYPE_DESC

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: CASE_ID
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.description: Enforcement case identifier in RCRAInfo.

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: ENF_ACTION_DATE
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.description: Date the enforcement action was issued (MM/DD/YYYY string).

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: PENALTY_AMOUNT
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.description: Monetary penalty assessed for the enforcement action, in USD (stored as string).

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: ENF_COMP_ACTION_COST
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.description: Estimated cost of complementary/compliance actions required by the enforcement (stored as string).

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: ENF_ACTIVITY_LOCATION
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.description: Two-character state postal code where the enforcement activity was recorded.

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: ENF_AGENCY
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.description: Agency that issued the enforcement action (State, EPA, or Tribe).

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: ENF_IDENTIFIER
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.description: Identifier of the specific enforcement activity in RCRAInfo.

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.label: ENF_KEY
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_compliance.description: Composite key uniquely identifying the enforcement record in RCRAInfo.

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_Compliance_Summary.label: target_facility
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_Compliance_Summary.description: Target facility name from the project's seed facility list; key used to link facility-360 records across tables and views.

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_Compliance_Summary.label: PGM_SYS_ID
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_Compliance_Summary.description: RCRA site identification number (EPA ID) of the facility, assigned by the implementing state or EPA region; first two characters are the state postal code (e.g. TXD003913381). Program-system ID linking to RCRAInfo.

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_Compliance_Summary.label: REGISTRY_ID
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_Compliance_Summary.description: 12-digit unique facility identifier assigned by EPA's Facility Registry Service (FRS).

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_Compliance_Summary.label: TOTAL_EVALUATIONS
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_Compliance_Summary.description: Count of distinct RCRA compliance evaluations (inspections) recorded for the facility in RCRAInfo compliance monitoring and enforcement data.

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_Compliance_Summary.label: TOTAL_VIOLATIONS
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_Compliance_Summary.description: Count of RCRA compliance records for the facility where a violation determination is recorded (FOUND_VIOLATION populated) in RCRAInfo data.

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_Compliance_Summary.label: TOTAL_ENFORCEMENTS
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_Compliance_Summary.description: Count of distinct RCRA enforcement actions recorded for the facility in RCRAInfo compliance monitoring and enforcement data.

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_Compliance_Summary.label: LAST_EVALUATION_DATE
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_Compliance_Summary.description: Date of the most recent RCRA compliance evaluation recorded for the facility.

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_Compliance_Summary.label: LAST_ENFORCEMENT_DATE
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_Compliance_Summary.description: Date of the most recent RCRA enforcement action recorded for the facility (stored as an MM/DD/YYYY string).

epa_hazwaste.RCRA_Compliance_Summary.label: TOTAL_PENALTY_AMOUNT
epa_hazwaste.RCRA_Compliance_Summary.description: Sum of monetary penalty amounts in US dollars from RCRA enforcement actions recorded for the facility.

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: target_facility
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: Target facility name from the project's seed facility list; key used to link facility-360 records across tables and views.

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: PRIMARY_NAME
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: Primary facility name from EPA's Facility Registry Service (FRS).

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: PGM_SYS_ID
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: RCRA site identification number (EPA ID) of the facility, assigned by the implementing state or EPA region; first two characters are the state postal code (e.g. TXD003913381). Program-system ID linking to RCRAInfo.

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: REGISTRY_ID
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: 12-digit unique facility identifier assigned by EPA's Facility Registry Service (FRS).

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: FACILITY_NAME
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: Facility name from the EPA RCRAInfo handler record.

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: ACTIVITY_LOCATION
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: Two-character state postal code indicating the location of the agency regulating the handler (RCRAInfo activity location).

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: STREET_ADDRESS
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: Street address of the facility location from the RCRAInfo handler record.

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: CITY_NAME
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: City of the facility location from the RCRAInfo handler record.

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: STATE_CODE
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: State code of the facility location from the RCRAInfo handler record.

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: ZIP_CODE
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: ZIP code of the facility location from the RCRAInfo handler record.

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: LATITUDE83
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: Latitude of the facility in decimal degrees, NAD83 datum, from the RCRAInfo handler record.

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: LONGITUDE83
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: Longitude of the facility in decimal degrees, NAD83 datum, from the RCRAInfo handler record.

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: FED_WASTE_GENERATOR
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: RCRAInfo federal waste generator status code, determined by the quantity and/or toxicity of hazardous waste generated: 1 = Large Quantity Generator (LQG), 2 = Small Quantity Generator (SQG), 3 = Very Small Quantity Generator (VSQG, formerly CESQG), N = not a generator; blank/null = unverified.

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: TRANSPORTER
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: Y/N flag from RCRAInfo; Y indicates the handler is engaged in the transportation of hazardous waste.

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: ACTIVE_SITE
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: RCRAInfo active-site indicator string; each position flags potential activity subject to RCRA regulation: H = Handler activities, P = Permitting activities, A = Corrective Action activities, C = Converter, S = State-specific activities; '-' = not active (e.g. 'HP---' = active handler and permitting activities).

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: OPERATING_TSDF
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: RCRAInfo Operating TSDF universe indicator; letters flag the operating treatment/storage/disposal unit types at the facility: L = Land Disposal, I = Incinerator, B = Boiler/Industrial Furnace, S = Storage, T = Treatment, H = Solid Waste Management; all dashes = not in the operating TSDF universe (e.g. 'LI-ST-').

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: FAC_NAME
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: Facility name from the EPA Facility Registry Service (FRS) record.

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: FAC_STREET
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: Street address of the facility from the EPA Facility Registry Service (FRS) record.

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: FAC_CITY
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: City of the facility from the EPA Facility Registry Service (FRS) record.

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: FAC_STATE
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: State of the facility from the EPA Facility Registry Service (FRS) record.

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: FAC_ZIP
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: ZIP code of the facility from the EPA Facility Registry Service (FRS) record.

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: FAC_COUNTY
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: County of the facility from the EPA Facility Registry Service (FRS) record.

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: FAC_EPA_REGION
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: EPA region (01-10) in which the facility is located, from the FRS record.

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: LATITUDE_MEASURE
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: Latitude of the facility in decimal degrees from the EPA Facility Registry Service (FRS) record.

epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.label: LONGITUDE_MEASURE
epa_hazwaste.FRS_Facility_profile.description: Longitude of the facility in decimal degrees from the EPA Facility Registry Service (FRS) record.

transport_ops.transporter_manifests.label: MANIFEST TRACKING NUMBER
transport_ops.transporter_manifests.description: EPA manifest tracking number (MTN) this leg belongs to. Joins to e_manifest.

transport_ops.transporter_manifests.description: EPA identification number of the transporter carrying the leg.

transport_ops.transporter_manifests.label: TRANSPORTER NAME
transport_ops.transporter_manifests.description: Registered name of the transporter company.

transport_ops.transporter_manifests.description: Position of this leg in the shipment’s custody chain, starting at 1.

transport_ops.transporter_manifests.label: PICKUP DATE
transport_ops.transporter_manifests.description: Date the transporter took custody of the shipment.

transport_ops.transporter_manifests.label: DELIVERY DATE
transport_ops.transporter_manifests.description: Date custody passed to the next transporter or to the receiving facility.

transport_ops.transporter_manifests.label: ORIGIN STATE
transport_ops.transporter_manifests.description: US state the leg departed from.

transport_ops.transporter_manifests.label: DESTINATION STATE
transport_ops.transporter_manifests.description: US state the leg arrived in.

transport_ops.transporter_manifests.label: QUANTITY TONS
transport_ops.transporter_manifests.description: Tonnage moved on this leg, as declared on the manifest.

transport_ops.transporter_manifests.label: CONTAINER COUNT
transport_ops.transporter_manifests.description: Number of containers on the leg.

transport_ops.transporter_manifests.label: HAZARD CLASS
transport_ops.transporter_manifests.description: DOT hazard class declared for the load. An attribute of the shipment, not an entity.

transport_ops.transporter_manifests.label: SIGNATURE CAPTURED
transport_ops.transporter_manifests.description: Whether an electronic signature was captured at hand-off.

transport_ops.route_segments.label: SEGMENT ID
transport_ops.route_segments.description: Surrogate key for the origin→destination segment.

transport_ops.route_segments.label: MANIFEST TRACKING NUMBER
transport_ops.route_segments.description: Manifest the segment belongs to. Joins to e_manifest and to transporter_manifests.

transport_ops.route_segments.label: ORIGIN FACILITY ID
transport_ops.route_segments.description: EPA handler id of the facility the segment departed from.

transport_ops.route_segments.label: DESTINATION FACILITY ID
transport_ops.route_segments.description: EPA handler id of the facility the segment arrived at.

transport_ops.route_segments.label: ORIGIN ADDRESS
transport_ops.route_segments.description: Street address on file for the origin handler.

transport_ops.route_segments.label: DESTINATION LAT
transport_ops.route_segments.description: Latitude of the destination handler, from the FRS facility record.

transport_ops.route_segments.label: DESTINATION LON
transport_ops.route_segments.description: Longitude of the destination handler, from the FRS facility record.

transport_ops.route_segments.label: TRANSIT HOURS

compliance_sandbox.enforcement_staging.label: REVIEWER EMAIL
compliance_sandbox.enforcement_staging.description: Address of the reviewer who cleared the row. Personal data.

compliance_sandbox.enforcement_staging.label: REVIEW NOTE
compliance_sandbox.enforcement_staging.description: Free-text note the reviewer left when clearing or rejecting the row.

epa_hazwaste.cw_project_gate_log.description: What the gate released against the envelope, in dollars.
